question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Something that is so extraordinary or unbelievable that it's hard to believe it
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Incredible"** means something that is so extraordinary or unbelievable that it is hard to believe. (अविश्वसनीय)
 
 
• **Example: **The magician performed an incredible trick that left the audience in awe.
 
 
 
• **"Horrible"** refers to something that causes horror; it is very unpleasant. (भयानक)
 
 
• **Example: **The movie had a horrible ending that left everyone feeling uneasy.
 
 
 
• **"Ordinary"** means something that is commonplace or usual. (साधारण)
 
 
• **Example: **It was just an ordinary day at work with nothing special happening.
 
 
 
• **"Exquisite"** refers to something that is extremely beautiful and delicate. (अति सुंदर)
 
 
• **Example: **The artist created an exquisite painting that captivated everyone.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Horrible **(भयानक): Something that causes horror or is very unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** The accident was a horrible experience for everyone involved.
 
 
 
• **Ordinary **(साधारण): Commonplace or usual.
 
 
• **Example:** She wore an ordinary dress to the party, nothing too fancy.
 
 
 
• **Exquisite** (अति सुंदर): Extremely beautiful and delicate.
 
 
• **Example:** The jeweler displayed an exquisite collection of diamond rings.
